topPRs.title: Add Voxel Resonance tokens (SGUIDE, VDOO, PENNIES, PIDX)
topPRs.author: jvoidial
topPRs.body:
This PR adds four tokens from the Voxel Resonance ecosystem on Base chain.

All contracts are verified on BaseScan and Sourcify, ownership renounced, and liquidity is active on Uniswap V2.

Token details:
- SGUIDE: 0xb50DCEb0570557B9B7FE43D8cBDc9B3457D3dc5a
- VDOO: 0x38e4f08D08b4D772A7B75669C356b4749dd2d30b
- PENNIES: 0x2a92CAA3b01E64634e2E95AA533a5570a76c19A7
- PIDX: 0xa36E026FC453880537e10d21fC139439bD2702fc

Ecosystem website: https://jvoidial.github.io/spirit-guide-token/
Safety report: https://jvoidial.github.io/spirit-guide-token/SAFETY_REPORT.md

topPRs.title: Add UVP (Uniswap V4 Airdrop Points) on Base
topPRs.author: ameniki
topPRs.body:
Adds the UVP token (Uniswap V4 Airdrop Points) on Base mainnet.

On-chain values verified:
- name: Uniswap V4 Airdrop Points
- symbol: UVP
- decimals: 18
- address: 0xcc1F0ef1D246d3c1849324F29c41F87F8c3a50cB
- website: https://uvp-claim.pages.dev

(Note: a duplicate PR was previously opened against the mode-network/superchain-tokenlist mirror — this is the active upstream repo.)
